purpose: Tracks candidate / incubating / deployed strategies per market regime quadrant and asset class. This file is an INDEX, never an authority: config/portfolios.json decides what is routed and approved_incubator/<id>/meta.json decides what was certified. A disagreement is resolved against those two, never against this.

quadrant_authority.note: The Q1..Q4 numbering is mdlib/regimes.py's and nothing else's. config/portfolios.json schema 1.0.0 numbered these incompatibly - every digit named a different environment - and 1.1.0 relabels them to agree. Never renumber these to match another document; a live daemon and a backtest disagreeing about what Q1 means is invisible downstream, because every log line still reads correctly.
quadrant_authority.adx_comparator: STRICT '>' , not '>='. mdlib/regimes.py and backtest/profiler.py have always used '>' and every cached quadrant, Stage 1 designation and Gate R verdict was drawn on it. At ADX exactly 25.00000 the bar is RANGING.

theta_vol.definition: median(ATR_14) over the pinned in-sample anchor
theta_vol.note: theta_vol is LOADED from the pinned anchor, never computed over a caller's window. A median taken over the request's own window is a property of the REQUEST, not the contract: on a quiet morning every bar reads high-volatility and a Q1-certified strategy is handed permission for a market it is not in. It is per (symbol, TIMEFRAME) - NQ is 7.90 at 15m and 11.33 at 30m, a 43% different boundary on the same tape - so this file stores no theta_vol value at all; read it through mdlib.regimes.provenance().

undefined_quadrant.label: Undefined (indicator warm-up)
undefined_quadrant.note: 0 IS NOT A QUADRANT and has no row in the matrix. It is indicator warm-up, where adx_14/atr_14 are NaN. The naive encoding files every warm-up bar under Low-Vol/Ranging, because NaN > 25.0 is False.

timeframes_note: The screened ladder. 1m/2m/3m are deliberately absent: friction per unit of edge removed them, and pre-2013 1-minute data is sparse for ten symbols (see intraday_start_year).
states_note: candidate  = swept and certified, nothing promoted; incubating = promoted into approved_incubator/ and routed on an incubator portfolio; deployed   = routed on an Eval or Prop portfolio. Being in approved_incubator/ is a record that a version was CHOSEN and is explicitly not permission to trade it.
asset_classes_note: All 24 have a verified ContractSpec and a symbol= partition in the lake. CL is BACKTEST-ONLY here: NinjaTrader on this box streams no CL series, so it can be swept and certified but not routed live. No existing module owned this symbol->class mapping; it is declared here for the first time.

Q1.note: PROMOTED BUT NOT ROUTED - promote.py refused the registration because no incubator portfolio's basket carries this contract or its micro, so the live loop would refuse it on every asset and it could never place an order. It is not tradeable until a basket carries the contract.

strategies_note: Promoted packages indexed by the quadrant Gate R CERTIFIED them in, resolved from each meta.json's target_regime against this file's own `quadrants` labels rather than a second copy of the numbering. `routed` is the load-bearing field: an entry with routed=false is on disk and in git but absent from config/portfolios.json, and CANNOT trade. Counting entries here as live strategies is the mistake this field exists to prevent.
